en: Colorized postcard view showing a busy spa pavilion covered with garlands in a park-like setting, labeled "Bad Pyrmont – Stahlbrunnen." A tall church spire rises in the background and townspeople in period dress gather around the octagonal wellhouse. The reverse has a green 6‑pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp with a BAD PYRMONT postmark, an advertising cancel for spa cures, a museum cachet, publisher information, and handwritten message in German.
